entities.summary: Codex Guelferbytanus B,, designated by Q or 026, ε 4, is a Greek uncial manuscript of the Gospels, dated palaeographically to the 5th century. It is a palimpsest. Codex Guelferbytanus B is a manuscript. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
